summary: SPHINCS+ variant with PORS+FP, a forced-pruning single-tree few-time signature: the full 256-bit digest gives a 34-bit index and 15 leaves of one height-14 tree; the signer grinds ρ until they are distinct with an octopus of ≤ 120 nodes. 5 layers (heights 11,6,6,6,5) of target-sum WOTS (42 chains, T = 182), cached height-11 top tree under a MAC, paired PRF secrets. Verify runs a stack machine on the expanded witness. S = 6,100, W = 6,348, K = 131,072 B, C = 11,907.

facts.label: Signature layout
facts.value: ρ 16 B + 15 sorted secrets 240 B + 120 auth slots 1,920 B + 5 layers 3,924 B = 6,100 B

facts.label: Message digest split
facts.value: Full 256-bit H(tw ‖ P ‖ ρ ‖ 0¹²⁸ ‖ m): idx 34 b ‖ 15 leaf indices × 14 b ‖ 12 unused bits

facts.label: PORS+FP admissibility
facts.value: Signer grinds ρ until the 15 indices are distinct and their octopus ≤ 120 nodes: p ≈ 2⁻⁹·⁷⁶, ≈ 870 tries

facts.label: PORS tree
facts.value: One height-14 tree (16,384 leaves) per idx; octopus = pruned auth set, read order, zero padded to 120

facts.label: Hypertree and WOTS
facts.value: 5 layers, heights 11,6,6,6,5; target-sum WOTS, 42 chains of w = 3 bits, digit sum 182, counter c < 2²²

facts.label: Keygen cache (K = 131,072 B)
facts.value: Height-11 top tree: 4,094 nodes each ⊕ a PRF mask + 256-bit MAC; one PRF call yields two secrets

facts.label: Witness (W = 6,348 B)
facts.value: ρ ‖ π (slot codes) ‖ 15 secrets ‖ 29 segments: 8 B header a | 16·merge | 32·t + a nodes ‖ layers ‖ counters

facts.label: Verification cost
facts.value: 9,784 + 17·folds + 2·(segments with folds) ≤ 11,882 proved, + 25 → C = 11,907; measured avg 11,834

profile.method: 16 random keys and 32-byte messages (seeded PRNG): ref.py keygen + sign, expand on the emulator, verify traced on vm.py; all accepted, 11,764–11,870 cycles, octopus 114–120
